Develop a research question, then answer it through a short data story mainly composed of [effective visualizations](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Q-C0sFxYGQvkxb6PU6OM_YOv6Nilalpk-IWb362PoRc/preview?slide=id.g13360dab5d5_0_61#slide=id.g13360dab5d5_0_61).  Provide sufficient background for readers to grasp your narrative.  Refer to the Homework Instructions ⭐ page on the course website for details on how to submit this part.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
ai_salary_majors <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-20/ai_salary_majors.csv')
major_occupations <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-20/major_occupations.csv')
glimpse(ai_salary_majors)
summary(ai_salary_majors)
glimpse(major_occupations)
summary(major_occupations)
```
```{r}
selected_fields <- c(
  "Engineering",
  "Computer Science",
  "Business",
  "Health Professions"
)

major_comparison <- ai_salary_majors |>
  filter(broad_field_short %in% selected_fields) |>
  drop_na(
    median_starting_salary,
    ai_exposure_percentile
  )

major_comparison |>
  count(broad_field_short)

field_summary <- major_comparison |>
  group_by(broad_field_short) |>
  summarise(
    n_majors = n(),
    median_earnings = median(median_starting_salary),
    median_exposure = median(ai_exposure_percentile),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(median_earnings))

field_summary
```
```{r}
field_order <- field_summary |>
  arrange(median_earnings) |>
  pull(broad_field_short)

major_comparison <- major_comparison |>
  mutate(
    broad_field_short = factor(
      broad_field_short,
      levels = field_order
    )
  )
```



```{r}
plot_faceted <- ggplot(
  major_comparison,
  aes(
    x = ai_exposure_percentile,
    y = median_starting_salary,
    color = broad_field_short
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ broad_field_short,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Engineering" = "#26547C",
      "Computer Science" = "#ef476f",
      "Business" = "#ffd166",
      "Health Professions" = "#06d6a0"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) x / 1000
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation between AI exposure and early-career earnings",
    subtitle = "The correlation between AI exposure and earnings varies by field.",
    x = "AI exposure percentile",
    y = "Earnings one year after graduation (thousands of USD)",
    caption = paste0(
      "Jason You | November 2, 2026",
      "\nSources: US Department of Education and AIOE Index | TidyTuesday dataset: October 20, 2026"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    # Keep only faint horizontal gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "grey92",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),

    # White background
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    # Titles
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      margin = margin(b = 12)
    ),

    # Axis text
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),

    # Left-align facet titles
    strip.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0
    ),

    # Gray, left-aligned caption
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey50",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

plot_faceted


```
```{r}
plot2 <- ggplot(
  major_comparison,
  aes(
    x = ai_exposure_percentile,
    y = broad_field_short
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.5,
    fill = "#F5E1D6",
    color = "#B85C38",
    alpha = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0,
      height = 0.12,
      seed = 253
    ),
    color = "#B85C38",
    size = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "AI exposure across different field",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Field order matches Figure 1;",
      "points farther right indicate greater exposure."
    ),
    x = "AI exposure percentile",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Author: Jason You",
      "\nSource: US Department of Education, AIOE Index, Tidytuesday"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot2

```
